_about: The kit's research database: SOURCES (what exists + its terms), QUESTIONS (what a design needs), FINDINGS (answers, each quoted from a PERMITTED source). Rules + how to dispatch research: references/README.md. Validate: node checks/claims-references-are-sound.mjs. A town's state is DERIVED from its own geography — never listed here.
